issues.description: The template file exports the data symbol 'hello' (line declares 'global hello') while the solution keeps that symbol private (no 'global' directive). The template also includes a 'Do not change this section' comment above the data declarations, which would tell students not to alter visibility. This creates a visibility mismatch between template and solution and is likely to confuse students: either the data is meant to be private (as in the solution) and the template incorrectly exports it, or the solution removed an export that students are told not to change.
issues.suggested_fix: Make visibility consistent: either remove the 'global hello' from the template so the data is private (matching the solution), or add 'global hello' to the solution and update the repository comments. Also update the 'Do not change this section' comment or the problem statement to clarify whether students are expected to change visibility so there is no contradiction between template and solution.
